acceptance: Each listed query's implementation reads every value the SQL varies and has an adapter
The inventory test's HARD_CODED list is empty or each remaining query has a documented reason
With the adapter binding, each query matches the DuckDB reference on both families at SF 0.1, or the reason is documented
No other query's status changes in the SF 0.1 per-query probe
description: These eight implementations cannot take the dsqgen draw: they read one value or none (Q41 hard-codes colors and has no adapter by design; Q88 also has a literal fallback and an incomplete pandas run in the inventory). Each needs a rewrite so the implementation reads the values the SQL varies, then an adapter as in t04, removal from HARD_CODED in the inventory test, and deletion of dead YAML keys. Eight is within the inventory's budget of 15 hard-coded queries (test_hard_coded_queries_stay_within_the_adapter_budget). Q41 is the t04 negative control: its binding must be added deliberately and the control re-pointed. queries.py PRs queue one at a time. Effort about 3 to 4 days (judgement, not measured).
